scheme_name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands Scheme for Health Insurance
other_conditions: Applicants must be settled in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands
Government pensioners must have dependent family members
Beneficiary must be referred by a specialist of GB Pant Hospital, Port Blair and complete codal formalities at the Nodal Cell (ANISHI)
Travel expense reimbursement is not provided for emergency treatment during a personal mainland visit
Eligibility category noted in source: Below Poverty Level
Eligibility category noted in source: Government pensioners
Eligibility category noted in source: Permanent resident
benefits_summary: Cashless medical treatment up to ₹5 lakh per patient per illness, with travel expense reimbursements for one attendant (bunk class fare or flight ticket for critically ill patients).
